title: Anti-proliferative action, molecular investigation and computational studies of novel fused heterocyclic cellulosic compounds on human cancer cells.
authors: Elsayed, Ghada H; Dacrory, Sawsan; Fahim, Asmaa M
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦新型纤维素杂环化合物的抗癌活性评估与分子对接，虽含计算模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Reactivity of MCEC (3) with diazonium chloride, DMF-DMA and NH(2)NH(2) to afford fused heterocyclic cellulosic derivative which confirmed through spectral analysis. Also, the cellulosic compounds were evaluated their growth inhibitory activity contra cancer cells A549 and Caco2 using neutral red uptake assay. Compounds, MCEN(6), MCPT(5a), MCPT(5b) showed better growth inhibitory activity on A549 and Caco2 growth compared to control values. While compound MCPY(7) exerted the best cytotoxic activity against A549 cells after 48 h. The expression levels of HIF-1alpha, beta-Catenin, MYC, Cyclin D1 and MMP7 genes in A549 cells were examined using QRT-PCR. The compounds MCEN(6) and MCPY(7) down regulated levels of beta-Catenin, MYC, Cyclin D1 and MMP7 genes and up-regulated levels of HIF-1alpha when treated with A549 cells compared to control values. Also, these biological studies confirmed through docking stimulation with different proteins and showed least binding energy with amino acids and attached with NH(2) and OH of cellulose with hydrogen bond interaction. Moreover, optimization of compounds using DFT/6-311(G) showed the stability of them and identifies their physical descriptors which showed excellent correlation with experimental results. Noteworthy, compounds, MCEN(6) and MCPY(7) were most promising anticancer agents against lung cancer through the regulation of apoptosis, cell cycle, proliferation, progression, chemo-resistance, and angiogenesis.
abstract_zh: MCEC（3）与重氮氯化物、DMF-DMA和NH(2)NH(2)反应生成稠合杂环纤维素衍生物，并通过光谱分析确认其结构。此外，采用中性红摄取实验评估了纤维素化合物对癌细胞A549和Caco2的生长抑制活性。与对照值相比，化合物MCEN(6)、MCPT(5a)、MCPT(5b)对A549和Caco2生长表现出更好的抑制活性，而化合物MCPY(7)在48小时后对A549细胞显示出最强的细胞毒性活性。通过QRT-PCR检测了A549细胞中HIF-1alpha、β-Catenin、MYC、Cyclin D1和MMP7基因的表达水平。与对照值相比，化合物MCEN(6)和MCPY(7)处理A549细胞后，下调了β-Catenin、MYC、Cyclin D1和MMP7基因的表达水平，并上调了HIF-1alpha的水平。此外，这些生物学研究通过不同蛋白质的对接模拟得到证实，显示出与氨基酸的最低结合能，并通过氢键相互作用与纤维素的NH(2)和OH基团结合。同时，使用DFT/6-311(G)对化合物进行优化，显示了它们的稳定性，并确定了其物理描述符，这些描述符与实验结果表现出极好的相关性。值得注意的是，化合物MCEN(6)和MCPY(7)通过调控凋亡、细胞周期、增殖、进展、化疗耐药性和血管生成，成为最具前景的抗肺癌药物。
